title: order-service Incident
evidence: Slow query logs confirmed 4.2s sequence scans on orders
verification: HTTP 504 errors ceased across all pods
root_cause: Unindexed foreign key lookups starved PostgreSQL connection pool.
resolution: Added btree index on orders(user_id) and scaled PgBouncer pool to 100.

timeline.event: Incident resolved: Unindexed foreign key lookups starved PostgreSQL connection pool.
